Q: How do I reset my password?
A: Open Settings > Security > Reset password. A link is valid for 30 minutes.
Q: Can I change my username?
A: Only once, within the first 14 days after sign-up.
Q: Where is my invoice?
A: Billing > Invoices, PDFs are kept for 24 months.
